eras.label: Vinci
eras.sum: Born near Vinci in 1452. The family note and the 1457 tax return fix his birth and his legal status.

eras.label: Florence
eras.sum: Training in the workshop of Andrea del Verrocchio, guild entry in 1472, and an independent practice by the late 1470s.

eras.label: Milan, Sforza court
eras.sum: In the service of Ludovico Sforza. The Virgin of the Rocks, the Sforza horse and the Last Supper belong to these years.

eras.label: Mantua, Venice, Florence
eras.sum: Flight from the French conquest, military service under Cesare Borgia, and the Palazzo della Signoria commission.

eras.label: Milan, French governors
eras.sum: Employed by Charles d'Amboise, with the Melzi household and sustained notebook work on water, geology and anatomy.

eras.label: Rome
eras.sum: Lodged at the Belvedere under the patronage of Giuliano de' Medici.

eras.label: Amboise
eras.sum: Residence at Cloux near Amboise under Francis I, ending with his death on 2 May 1519.
